title: Diagnostic Procedure for Isolated Instrument Sensor Faults

reference_limits.rate_of_change_threshold: 30% excursion in < 2 seconds with zero causal correlation

steps: Verify if tag excursion occurs without any upstream or downstream deviation in the causal topology.
Inspect 4-20mA loop integrity, terminal wiring, and power supply on transmitter junction box.
Perform local field gauge cross-check to verify whether physical process variable is actually deviant.
If local reading matches nominal baseline, place DCS loop in manual mode and flag transmitter for recalibration.
Replace faulty sensor cartridge or signal conditioner and perform zero/span calibration prior to re-enabling alarms.
